description: Empirical power lookup vs significant wave height Hs (Pelamis-type attenuator). P = J(Hs,Te)*capture_width*CWR*eta_pto*eta_electrical, J=(rho*g^2/64pi)*Hs^2*Te. Capped at rated power (~Pelamis P2 750 kW).

Te_ref_s.note: Representative energy period for the lookup

P_rated_kw.note: Rated electrical power (Pelamis P2), curve clipped at rating

power_kw.note: Electrical power at Te=9 s, clipped at 750 kW rated

source: Henderson (2006) Appl. Ocean Res. 28:297-307; Yemm et al. (2012) Phil. Trans. R. Soc. A 370:365-380 (Pelamis P2); reuses EC137 F1a parameters
